boundaries.name: compiler_and_field_lowering
boundaries.obligation: Handwritten order/data/gates do not prove equivalence to Rust/Plonky2 compiled constraints or bytecode. FieldAndGadgetLowering must justify actual safe Booleans, checked word ranges, integer-lifted counts, equality/select/connection and local U64 carry equations without circular asset-safety premises.

boundaries.name: primitive-semantics-faithfulness
boundaries.obligation: each `BuildOp.holds` case equals what the corresponding plonky2 primitive enforces; the pinned circuit digest is the digest of `constructorProgram`

boundaries.name: typed_words_and_pis
boundaries.obligation: Native u8/u16/u32/u64/U256 and field encodings, setter canonical conversion, hash limb representation and exact target indices must refine decoded Nat/List structures. Shape failure in target parsing denotes assertion panic. Source target parser does not independently check ranges.

boundaries.name: h1_poseidon_and_keccak
boundaries.obligation: Exact37/139/42/12/92/66 preimages are modeled, but Poseidon/Keccak gadgets and native byte agreement are not verified. HashBindingAt applies only to the concrete compared pair, including canonical Poseidon-to-Bytes32 encoding; no globally injective finite hash is assumed.

boundaries.name: constant_and_cyclic_verifier_pins
boundaries.obligation: Both verifier data are constructor parameters. Correct supplied/deployed canonical keys, recursive verifier soundness, Balance cyclic embedded-key parsing/connection and aggregate arity/PI integrity must be established separately. Constant pinning and equal arity alone are not canonical-family proofs.

boundaries.name: aggregate_falcon_statement
boundaries.obligation: For each actual pinned aggregate proof, supply exact message/count/key-list, active-prefix verified Falcon signatures and canonical key/message limb ranges. AggregateContractAt states only the scoped signature proposition, not member registration, honest economic transition or asset solvency.

boundaries.name: finite_indexed_insertion_paths
boundaries.obligation: Each visited concrete indexed-tree path requires valid predecessor links/order, low-leaf and empty-leaf openings, full-key comparisons and same-path replacement/skip semantics. ScopedInsertionContracts supplies per-step nonmembership and root updates; no all-key/global hash injectivity assertion is used.

boundaries.name: native_close_and_balance_dependencies
boundaries.obligation: closeToPublicInputs delegates CloseIntent::new plus exact-intent equality; parseBalance delegates current first29 BalancePublicInputs parser. Those native helper bodies, ChannelState/BalanceState native computation and memory/assertion behavior require separate translations. Native success is not a raw circuit soundness premise.

boundaries.name: native_witness_and_proof_generation
boundaries.obligation: PartialWitness assignments/unwrap panics, proof-target shape checks, native indexed-tree generators and CircuitData.prove are opaque operations with preserved order/error categories. No assertion that filled witnesses necessarily prove or that a signed exit kit is always available.

boundaries.name: l1_and_honest_signer_obligations
boundaries.obligation: L1 must match registered member set/count, active/frozen generation, finality, authorized and pending burn high-water and one exact full-state backing vector. Honest signer admission must enforce intended slot/recipient/ciphertext/delegate and unused-token canonicality rules. Close alone does not open slots, enforce delegate total<=1024, prove asset backing or select latest H.

boundaries.name: fixtures_and_tests
boundaries.obligation: Feature-gated fixture helpers1105–1556 remain explicitly untranslated; they are not merely test-only. Unit-test source1558–2402 is read but not mapped to production constraints. No Rust proving/adversarial/fixture regeneration tests were run by this module.
